label: v185
changes: The answer now appears in the chat itself. Ask what your lease says about repairs and the clauses come back in the conversation, with page numbers, quoted word for word — no sheet to open, nothing to tap. The document speaks for itself, right where you asked.

Fixed: documents wouldn't load at all on the new address. Teluva's file storage was still only expecting the old web address, so every attempt to read a document failed with "Failed to fetch". Both addresses are now allowed.

When nothing matches, Teluva says exactly that — and says what it searched for, and names any page it couldn't read. It will not tell you your document doesn't mention something, because that is the one thing it has no way to know.
